bead.title: routing: ListModels(unfiltered) must enumerate available subscription-harness tiers
bead.description: PROBLEM (proven via reproducer 2026-05-29): when configured `providers:` are all down, `ddx work` fails beads with `no viable routing floor for inferred powerClass standard`. ROOT CAUSE: ddx builds its power-escalation ladder from `svc.ListModels(ModelFilter{})` (unfiltered). fizeau service_models.go:25-46 assembles unfiltered ListModels ONLY from the configured providers block; subscription-harness tiers (claude/codex/gemini) are returned ONLY when filter.Harness is set (service_models.go:26-27). So with local providers down, the unfiltered snapshot is empty → ddx ladder empty → resolvePowerFloor(PowerStandard) returns hasPowerFloor=false → route-unavailable, even though claude/codex are available. PROPOSED FIX: unfiltered ListModels should also enumerate available subscription-harness tiers via the existing path it uses for the filtered case (listModelsForSubprocessHarness / catalogTierModelsForHarnessSurface, service_routing.go:746-751), so the snapshot/ladder reflect available harnesses. NON-SCOPE: do not change filtered ListModels semantics; do not change scoring.
bead.acceptance:
1. New test TestListModelsUnfilteredIncludesAvailableSubscriptionTiers (fizeau): with no reachable HTTP providers but claude/codex available on PATH, ListModels(ModelFilter{}) returns the subscription-harness tiers (non-empty, with power metadata).
2. TestListModelsFilteredUnchanged: filtered-by-harness behavior is unchanged.
3. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && go test ./... green.
4. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
